turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
We currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process an order before it ships. For the contiguous U.S., estimated transit time after that is 1–3 days to the West Coast, 3–4 days to the Central U.S., 4–5 days to the Midwest, and 5–7 days to the East Coast. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
You’ll receive a tracking email when your order is ready to ship. Our Shipping & Delivery page has the latest time frames.

ur warranty policy on defective items?
Our manufacturer’s warranty covers manufacturing defects and shipping damage on items bought directly from us. For a broken or defective part, we provide a replacement at no charge; you don’t need to return the item. Damage from misuse or negligence isn’t covered, and purchases from third-party sellers fall under those sellers’ policies.
Our warranty page says replacement parts are available up to 90 days from purchase. You can submit a warranty claim here.
